title: Cancel an order before invoicing
objective: Confirm that a customer can cancel an order before invoicing once the observable success outcome is defined.
preconditions: A synthetic customer has an order that has not been invoiced.

test_data.name: pre-invoice order
test_data.description: A synthetic order that has not been invoiced.

steps.action: Request cancellation of the pre-invoice order.

notes: No message, status, resulting state, HTTP code, or side effect is asserted because ORD-005 does not define one.
